fishing: WHEN/PASSES-BEACH: snook and redfish early/late, pompano, whiting, jacks, Spanish mackerel, flounder (Blind/Stump Pass, beaches). LEMON BAY: redfish schools Miserable Mile to Tom Adams, mangrove snapper at Chadwick pier, snook into the ICW. NEARSHORE: red/gag grouper and snapper 95–150 ft. Baits: shrimp, soft plastics, live bait, pompano jigs.
redtide: FWC (Sep 18): K. brevis background in one Sarasota sample past week; no fish kills or respiratory irritation. Next FWC report Fri Sep 25.
bacteria: Englewood Beach / Manasota Key: GOOD (enterococci ~10 CFU/100mL). Sarasota gulf beaches Good.
